Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to successfully execute the search query. In Step 1, the agent reported typing the query "NOAA difference between weather and climate" and opening a page, but the provided text and screenshot metadata clearly show that the browser opened a DuckDuckGo search results page (indicated by "duckduckgo.com", "Upgrade to our browser", and "Only showing results from..."), not the specific NOAA.gov page the user intended. Instead of recognizing this failure to access the authoritative source and attempting to correct the query or navigate to the actual NOAA site, the agent proceeded in subsequent steps to assume it had gathered the necessary information and repeatedly re-ran the same ineffective search query without adapting its strategy to actually retrieve the specific content needed to distinguish between weather and climate in the context of flash floods. This failure to gather the correct initial data led to a reliance on preliminary intuition rather than verified evidence.
